  - BM25 + vector + RRF hybrid retrieval — a concrete recipe to improve search in /home/ubuntu/dev/agentmemory, which currently leans on Letta's retrieval.
  - The L0→L1→L2→L3 distillation ladder — a cleaner articulation of the layering our memory stack does implicitly. Worth stealing the vocabulary.
  - Skill extraction with versions + validation rules — maps directly onto our living rules/skills docs in /home/ubuntu/.config/coding-agents/.

  Recommendation

  Skip adoption. If you want the ideas, the cheap move is a read-only pass over MemoryCore's L1/L2 distillation prompts and the CodeGraph builder, feeding a BACKLOG
  item for agentmemory. I'd delegate that to Codex read-only — say the word and I'll scope it.

  If you ever do want to try it hands-on: standalone Hub only, no proxy, on an isolated host, never routed through Traefik/Authelia, and only after #673 merges.

  Want the mining pass, or an HTML version of this review for the library?
